muc.tiep_theo: MOI HOP DONG, CHUA CO BEN NAO NOI: chua ai phat va chua ai nghe, nen kb/30-indexes/event-flows.json van rong — va no la PLACEHOLDER (tools/kb/main.go:96 chi ghi khi tep chua co noi dung that), tuc `make kb` KHONG tu dien dong nay; phai viet tay dung luc producer/consumer dau tien ton tai. BA THU CO Y DE MO, khong phai lam thieu: (1) TRANG THAI NAO OWE MOT TIN — skills/petition-lifecycle chot ba buoc (tiep nhan, vao xu ly, dong phieu), nhung chin trang thai cua ADR 0027 co ba ma khong buoc nao trong bay buoc ay phu: `cho-dan-xac-nhan` (ca trang thai ton tai de CONG DAN lam gi do — khong bao thi no la trang thai chet), `khong-tiep-nhan` va `chuyen-cap-tren` (hai ket cuc cong dan phai duoc biet). Do la cau cua luat 10 (dieu kien dung #3), phai hoi khach, KHONG duoc suy tu hop dong; hop dong co y chi khai HINH DANG (`citizen_message` vang mat = khong no tin nhan) chu khong khai danh sach. (2) `next_step` va `status_label` phai do PHAN MEM soan theo trang thai, KHONG duoc lay van ban can bo go — ket qua dong phieu ma luat 10 bat bien 6 doi la thu cong dan doc BANG MA TRA CUU, khong phai thu day vao tin nhan: van ban tu do se co ngay mang ten nguoi bao, dia chi hay noi dung phan anh, va luc do ca hang doi lan so thong bao thanh kho du lieu ca nhan (luat 3). (3) NGUOI NHAN cho phieu `can-bo-nhap-ho`: su kien doi mot `citizen_id` mo cua identity, va chua ai noi mot phieu nhap ho co luon mot dinh danh cong dan hay khong — neu khong co thi khong co ai de bao, va cho ay phai SUY GIAM NHIN THAY DUOC chu khong duoc lang le khong phat su kien.

muc.tiep_theo: CANH BAO - CHUA GOI DUOC, VA DO LA DIEU KIEN DUNG CHUA AI TRA LOI; dung doc muc nay la 'xong het'. RPC nay KHONG THE mang "x-tenant-id": no CHINH LA thu phan giai xa cho kenh cong dan (ADR 0022, ADR 0005 - Mini App khong co ten mien), dung vong lap ADR 0012 muc A mo ta cho ResolveHost. Nen no phai co ten trong core/grpcx.methodsWithoutTenant, va ADR 0012 quyet dinh 1 noi THEM MOT TEN VAO DANH SACH AY LA DIEU KIEN DUNG - hoi nguoi dung, dung tu quyet trong luc viet ma. Hom nay ten ay KHONG co trong danh sach: interceptor ben goi tu choi tai cho voi InvalidArgument, handler khong bao gio chay. Su vang mat duoc ghim bang phep kiem - core/grpcx/grpcx_test.go TestDanhSachMienLaTuongMinh (ten nam trong danh sach KHONG-mien) va core/identityclient/phien_cong_dan_test.go TestPhienCongDanBiChanViKhongCoMienXa (do len dung ngay mien tru duoc them, de nguoi them biet cac ca kiem con lai toi nay chay tren mot loi goi chua tung roi tien trinh). MOT KHOANG TRONG THU HAI, DA VIET RA CHU KHONG DE AI PHAT HIEN LUC SU CO: core/httpx.CitizenSessions chi co HAI ket qua, nen bo noi SoPhienCongDan buoc phai gop 'identity chet' thanh 'khong co phien' - cong dan nhan 401 'Phien khong hop le hoac da ket thuc' trong khi phien van con nguyen. Duong can bo KHONG tra gia nay vi staffauth.Resolver co error va middleware tra 503. Cach sua da biet va CO Y chua lam: mo rong httpx.CitizenSessions.TraCuu tra them error, dan no tu CitizenEdge sang XaTuPhien, them nhanh 503 canh nhanh 401 - do la sua mot hop dong ria trong core/httpx ma ly le 'mot cau tra loi phu dinh duy nhat' duoc viet dai o core/httpx/citizen.go, nen la quyet dinh cua nguoi so huu tep ay. Dau vet duy nhat con lai cua viec gop la mot dong CANH BAO HA TANG, duoc ghim boi TestSoPhienCongDanGopLoiThanhKhongCoPhienVaGhiCanhBao. KHONG CHAM CAU HOI MO #25: RPC nay chi DOC so phien, khong tao va khong ghi vet cho phien chua chon xa; TaoChuaChonXa van chua co nguoi goi nao.
